title: Editor’s pick: Excelsior Sciences - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Each year, Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year. Excelsior Sciences is developing a closed-loop system for drug discovery using carbon building bloccs.
